description: This file defines API route handlers for managing notes in a web application using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, along with associated data models and dependency injections.

classes.name: DeleteResponse
classes.description: Response model used after deleting a note, indicating success status and a message.

methods.name: list_notes(user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id))
methods.description: Retrieve all notes for the authenticated user.

methods.name: create_note(payload: NoteCreate, user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id))
methods.description: Create a new note for the authenticated user with provided data.

methods.name: get_note( note_id: str = Path(..., description="ID of the note to retrieve"), user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Retrieve a specific note by ID for the authenticated user.

methods.name: update_note( payload: NoteUpdate, note_id: str = Path(..., description="ID of the note to update"), user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Update an existing note partially by ID.

methods.name: delete_note( note_id: str = Path(..., description="ID of the note to delete"), user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )

ctags.name: delete_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: str = Path(..., description="ID of the note to delete"), user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )

ctags.name: get_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: str = Path(..., description="ID of the note to retrieve"), user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )

ctags.name: success
ctags.pattern: /^    success: bool = Field(..., description="True if delete succeeded.")$/

ctags.signature: ( payload: NoteUpdate, note_id: str = Path(..., description="ID of the note to update"), user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
